title: Modeling elucidates context dependence in adipose regulation.
authors: Vasquez, Cameron D; Albeck, John G
one_liner_zh: 该文结合单细胞数据与计算模拟，建模HIF1alpha和PPARgamma转录因子在脂肪分化中的动态调控网络，虽涉及TF-DNA调控但未聚焦结合位点或互作机制，方法以网络模拟为主，与TF-DNA互作建模课题部分相关。
abstract: Single-cell data and computational simulations reveal the dynamics of the transcription factors HIF1alpha and PPARgamma during adipocyte differentiation and maturation. Modeling feedback within this network predicts a HIF1alpha-mediated choice between lipid accumulation and incomplete differentiation. In vitro experiments support this model, with implications for adipose dynamics in metabolic disorders involving hypoxia.
abstract_zh: 单细胞数据与计算模拟揭示了脂肪细胞分化及成熟过程中转录因子HIF1alpha和PPARgamma的动态变化。对该网络内反馈的建模预测了HIF1alpha介导的脂质积累与不完全分化之间的选择。体外实验支持该模型，对涉及缺氧的代谢紊乱中脂肪组织动态具有启示意义。
